label: Archival Specimen Cradle Kit
description: Materials used to create custom-fitted supports for fossils to prevent pressure points and structural failure during long-term storage.

components.function: Carved to the shape of the fossil to provide a soft, stable base.

components.description: A rigid fiberglass or plaster 'mother mold' that holds the foam and fossil in a fixed orientation.

components.function: A smooth, archival-grade fabric barrier placed between the fossil and the foam to prevent snagging.
Flexible foam 'snakes' used to fill gaps and provide lateral stability in a storage drawer.

game_mechanics.weight_distribution_puzzle: Player must identify the 'weak points' of a fossil (e.g., a thin mid-shaft) and place supports to equalize the load.
game_mechanics.archival_check: Using non-archival materials (like bubble wrap or acidic cardboard) causes the 'specimen health' bar to deplete over time.
